bundle.shortDescription: Realtime RGB-D capture and production reconstruction.
bundle.longDescription: ScanLan records calibrated RGB-D from Kinect v2, Azure Kinect DK, or Orbbec Femto Mega, tracks and fuses it in realtime, then builds metric point clouds, textured triangle meshes, and depth-aware 2D Gaussian surfaces.
